groups.sentence: Instructors build a culture of academic integrity in their classroom.
Instructors explain and promote academic integrity, honesty and trust to students at the start of the course.
Students ask whether their AI use is equitable to their peers.
Academic dishonesty with AI is considered wrong and leads to penalties.
Academic integrity is a core value and foundation of the academic community and its education.
AI use must be fair and equitable to all students, and unfair advantage is dishonest.
Honest work and disclosure let others trust that submissions reflect the student's own knowledge.
Students uphold academic integrity, honesty and fairness in their AI use.
